Your symptoms of severe abdominal/back pain, blood in urine, frequent urination, and pain during urination (MEDICAL.symptoms) indicate ongoing sensitivity and the need for careful management. The pain management, increased fluid intake, and medications you've taken (MEDICAL.treatments) are good steps, but it's crucial to discuss these with your doctor to ensure they are still appropriate and effective. Your pumpkin seed allergy (MEDICAL.allergies) is important to keep in mind when considering dietary changes.

Your enjoyment of strength training with kettlebells (fitness) is excellent for overall health and can help manage pain, but be mindful of any movements that exacerbate your abdominal or back pain. Consider consulting a physical therapist for exercises specifically tailored to your condition.
